title: User profile page crashes when loading large image
description: When a user uploads a profile picture larger than 5MB, the profile page crashes with a white screen. This affects both desktop and mobile users. The error appears to be related to image processing in the frontend.
stepsToReproduce: Upload an image larger than 5MB as profile picture
expectedBehavior: Profile page should load successfully with the uploaded image, possibly after resizing or compressing it automatically
actualBehavior: Page shows white screen and browser console shows 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' error
